problem: The shipping-region filter was agreed for a single selected region, but owners buy across two regions and cannot express that.
outcome: An owner filters listings by one or more shipping regions, so cross-region buying is expressible in one search.
scope: Show shipping regions on each result card.
Filter results by one or more selected shipping regions.
requirements: Each result card displays the seller's declared shipping regions.
The region filter accepts multiple regions and matches any selected region.
A listing with no declared regions is shown as unknown rather than excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting two regions returns listings shipping to either region.
Clearing the filter restores the unfiltered result set.
A listing with no declared regions renders as unknown and remains visible.

adr_disposition.reason: Filter semantics change only; no new component, store or trust boundary.

owner_decisions: Multi-region selection matches any selected region rather than all of them.
Saved region presets remain out of scope for this work item.

revision.reason: Later owner discussion materially changed the filter from a single region to multiple regions.
changed_requirements: The region filter accepts multiple regions and matches any selected region, replacing the agreed single-region filter.

unresolved.topic: Whether region selection should persist between sessions.

source.summary: Follow-up conversation changed the agreed requirement; the issue and PDR were updated before implementation resumed.
